neighbours.label: nouns of connection or involvement that relate one thing to another (link, connection, participation, involvement, fit, interest), as against the same sentences with a plain descriptive noun
fire: Researchers found a clear link between air pollution and asthma.
Voter participation in local elections has fallen sharply.
The bank denied any involvement in the money laundering scheme.
Critics questioned the connection between diet and mood.
Volunteers followed the restoration with keen interest.
Solar panels are a natural fit with home batteries.
The study examined the relationship between screen time and sleep.
Fans praised the team's engagement with local schools.
quiet: Researchers found a clear map of air pollution in the city.
Voter turnout signs in local elections were painted red.

Critics questioned the price of the new diet book.
Volunteers followed the restoration with a camera.

The study examined the size of screens in classrooms.
